title: Onda Andar totem (ships2016)
description: Transform your Minecraft survival with the ONDA ANDAR resource pack. This pack replaces the standard Totem of Undying with the iconic skull-and-bones symbol. Upon activation, instead of the default sound, you'll hear a voicetag (laugh)
body:
Elevate your gameplay with a touch of mystery and dark aesthetics. The ONDA ANDAR Resource Pack is a specialized cosmetic overhaul designed for players who want their achievements and survival moments to carry a distinct, high-energy signature. This pack focuses on one of the most crucial items in the game: the Totem of Undying.
Visual Overhaul
Say goodbye to the traditional golden figure. The totem has been completely re-skinned to feature the ONDA ANDAR emblem—a striking skull and crossbones. This custom sprite is designed with crisp details that stand out in your hotbar, signaling your allegiance to the ONDA ANDAR style. Whether you are engaging in high-stakes PvP or exploring dangerous dimensions, your "second life" has never looked more intimidating.
Immersive Audio Signature
The true highlight of this pack lies in its auditory feedback. We have replaced the vanilla totem activation sound with a custom-engineered voicetag sequence. Every time you cheat death, the game triggers a powerful audio cue. Drawing inspiration from iconic music production tags, the sound begins with a haunting, sinister laugh that echoes through the environment, followed by a rhythmic drop that mimics the intensity of an "EG" track.


#2016
